title: Design system: Alan Sahlan's personal website

blue-secondary.purpose: Contact-panel support copy and Shelf attribution only.

display.purpose: Desktop Home heading; responsive sizes are recorded in DESIGN.md.

headline.purpose: The existing Contact modal title; project titles have their own role.

about-heading.purpose: About introduction heading; 40px in the compact layout.

contact-heading.purpose: Shared contact-panel heading; 30px in the compact layout.

project-title.purpose: Project names below the preview artwork.

introduction.purpose: Home and About introduction copy; Home reduces to 16px in the compact layout.

project-description.purpose: Factual project descriptions below title and category.

project-category.purpose: Secondary project category, aligned with the title baseline.

shadows.name: quote-surface
shadows.purpose: A soft shadow around the Shelf bubble and its curved tail.

shadows.name: contact-modal
shadows.purpose: Contact modal above the blurred backdrop.

motion.name: motion-fast
motion.purpose: Button press and compact tooltip transitions.

motion.name: motion-base
motion.purpose: Shared hover and Shelf artwork transitions.

motion.name: quote-reveal
motion.purpose: One squash-and-stretch entrance, then rest. Disabled with reduced motion.

motion.name: quote-pointer-follow
motion.purpose: Short position easing for fine pointers. Reduced motion anchors body and tail to artwork, including live preference changes.

motion.name: quote-hover-delay
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer quote reveal delay; touch and keyboard reveal immediately. Scroll-into-view in the opening frame preserves a new pointer reveal; later user scrolling dismisses it.

motion.name: contact-magnet
motion.value: stiffness: 100; damping: 10; mass: 1; maximum pull: 18% of shorter dimension
motion.purpose: Shared contact-arrow and sidebar-pill feedback inside fixed hit areas. Liquid Gooey Move deforms only the silhouette; text and icons stay unfiltered. Touch gets press feedback; reduced motion and forced colors use static controls.

motion.name: portrait-print
motion.purpose: Quickly rotate the entire smaller photo print and reveal its caption without changing the photo crop or layout during hover. Use uniform image scaling and automatic height to preserve natural proportions. Reduced motion keeps it straight and reveals the caption immediately.

signature.lettering: Custom monoline Alan with tall capital A, looped l, connected a/n, and a short underline; ink token
signature.motion: First-arrival delight, one time at 80% visibility; ten directional SVG mask transforms using WAAPI and linear timing; shared fast/base/slow tokens total 1660ms
signature.accessibility: Accessible text Alan; decorative SVG hidden; full signature with reduced motion or no JavaScript; live preference changes finish writing immediately

mobileMenu.surface: Neutral canvas with ink links, gray profiles, current-page dot, radius-large corners, and a light #0000001f backdrop
mobileMenu.size: max 420px by 520px, constrained to page gutters and available dynamic viewport height
mobileMenu.anchor: 44px close target stays exactly over the hamburger, inset 16px inside the panel; window expands above and toward its trailing edge with 4px minimum viewport clearance; logical placement mirrors in RTL
mobileMenu.motion: One critical spring, damping ratio 1 and 0.3s response; shared reversible surface/backdrop/icon/content progress; transform and inverse transform preserve glyph and button size; position and velocity survive rapid retargeting
mobileMenu.reducedMotion: Final geometry and state immediately, including live preference changes; no spatial movement
mobileMenu.elevation: Outer drop-shadow(0 12px 24px #0000000d) drop-shadow(0 4px 8px #0000000a), separate from the inner reveal mask; system outlines in forced colors
mobileMenu.behavior: Focus trap, background scroll lock, Escape/backdrop close, focus restoration, close on page selection and desktop resize; Contact modal stacks above and restores its menu trigger

responsiveOverrides.behavior: Single-column shell up to 848px with the compact menu; project grid remains two columns from 600px through 1000px.

projectGrid.imageSourceSizing: Responsive source sizes allow for the roughly twofold crop of the supplied wide scenes.

characters.sidebar: 144px by 240px; vertical minimum 160px; margin 16px auto 0 reserves greeting clearance
characters.homeCompact: Home compact layout only (1000px and below): separate right grid column, 144px by 240px, 48px greeting allowance; desktop shows only the sidebar figure
characters.homePhone: Below 600px, 104px by 184px with 56px greeting allowance; full-width headline and text beside figure

greeting.lineWrapping: Single line on desktop and tablets; wraps inside the Home character column below 600px
greeting.desktopPlacement: Bubble and tail centered above the character
greeting.compactPlacement: 12px above Home figure, with centered phone tail and no text overlap

characters.aboutCompact: No caricature; use the portrait at the introduction top-right

shelf.reservedWidth: 112px: 48px edge padding and 64px for four gaps
shelf.scaledGeometry: Cover, stage, record, open-book, hit-area dimensions, and reveal offsets scale together. Hit areas stay fixed during reveals; text sizes remain unchanged.
shelf.quoteBehavior: Existing quote content, portal positioning, input handling, and reduced-motion behavior are unchanged.

aboutExperience.placement: Between the About introduction and Shelf
aboutExperience.dates: 13px secondary text, line height 1.6, tabular numerals
aboutExperience.desktop: Organization and role left, dates right, 18px row padding and fine separators
aboutExperience.phone: Below 600px dates stack beneath the role with a 6px gap

identity.compact: Name, role and Blob buddy grouped left; only the menu toggle right
identity.desktop: Identity and blob share the sidebar rail

aboutIntroduction.placement: Portrait floats top-right, text flows beside and beneath
aboutIntroduction.portraitWidths: 248px desktop, 220px compact desktop, 184px tablet, 128px phone, 104px below 360px

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 9999px); background: var(--ink, #0a0a0a); color: var(--canvas, #fff); font-family: var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--action-hover, #303030); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #0a0a0a); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 9999px); background: var(--subtle, #f7f7f7); color: var(--ink, #0a0a0a); font-family: var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-secondary:hover { background: var(--hover, #e8e8e8); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #0a0a0a); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-secondary:active { transform: scale(.97); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-secondary { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Desktop Home and About navigation uses a gray current-page fill. At compact widths, a neutral canvas panel with soft shadow, an inset close target, and perspective links contains existing contact/resume actions and social profiles.
components.html: HomeKnow me better
components.css: .ds-navigation { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 9999px); color: var(--secondary, #626262); font-family: var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current=page] { background: var(--secondary-action, #f2f2f2); color: var(--ink, #0a0a0a); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--subtle, #f7f7f7); color: var(--ink, #0a0a0a); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #0a0a0a); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-item { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

components.name: Skill list
components.description: Flat static skill labels with fine separators and no action states.
components.css: .ds-skills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 12px; padding: 0; margin: 0; list-style: none; font-family: var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-skills li { color: var(--secondary, #626262); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; } .ds-skills li:not(:last-child) { padding-right: 12px; border-right: 1px solid var(--border-control, #d6d6d6); }

components.name: Project preview
components.description: Static flat article with a 3:2 artwork frame and caption below. The token preview omits the supplied artwork.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-project { min-width: 0; color: var(--ink, #0a0a0a); font-family: var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-project-artwork { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-large, 16px); background: var(--subtle, #f7f7f7); } .ds-project-caption { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-top: 16px; } .ds-project-heading { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px 16px; } .ds-project-heading h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-project-heading > span { color: var(--muted, #707070); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-project-caption > p { margin: 0; color: var(--secondary, #626262); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Contact panel
components.description: Shared pale-blue contact panel. This static token preview omits the separately documented magnetic arrow.
components.html:
Have something in mind?

A project, a role, or a good conversation. I’d love to hear about it.
components.css: .ds-contact { padding: 40px; border-radius: var(--radius-large, 16px); background: var(--blue-surface, #edf3ff); font-family: var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-contact h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #0a0a0a); font-size: 36px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-contact > p { max-width: var(--reading-width, 640px); margin: 12px 0 0; color: #50698b; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; } @media (max-width: 1250px) { .ds-contact { padding: 32px; } } @media (max-width: 1000px) { .ds-contact { padding: 24px; } .ds-contact h2 { font-size: 30px; } }

components.name: Shelf quote bubble
components.description: The shared game, film, and book quote treatment. The live component supplies viewport clamping, placement, and input handling.
components.html:
“The world doesn’t need a hero. It needs a professional.”

Geralt of Rivia
components.css: .ds-quote-wrap { width: 320px; max-width: calc(100vw - 48px); padding-block: 14px; } .ds-quote { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 22px 24px; border-radius: 26px 30px 28px 12px; background: var(--blue-surface, #edf3ff); color: #18365b; filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 12px #183d7318); font-family: var(--font-sans, Arial, sans-serif); transform-origin: 44px bottom; animation: ds-quote-reveal 220ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) both; } .ds-quote p { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 450; line-height: 1.55; letter-spacing: -.08px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-quote-author { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; color: #50698b; } .ds-quote-tail { position: absolute; left: 32px; bottom: -12px; fill: var(--blue-surface, #edf3ff); } @keyframes ds-quote-reveal { 0% { opacity: .7; transform: translateY(4px) scale(.97,1.02); } 60% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.012,.992); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } @media (max-height: 400px) { .ds-quote { padding: 14px 18px; } .ds-quote p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-quote { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
This records the existing Home and About implementation. White space, dark text, restrained cobalt accents, and cover artwork carry the pages. The Alan character and Blob buddy provide the site's playful interactions. Geist carries the interface and prose; Caveat marks personal notes.

The Shelf quote bubble is a local extension approved on 2026-10-26. Its pale-blue fill relates to the existing Blob buddy and contact panel. It does not replace the site's buttons, Contact modal tooltips, or other containers.
keyCharacteristics: A white canvas with gray controls and fine separators.
Rounded controls and artwork within flat project articles.
Brief input feedback with keyboard, touch, and reduced-motion alternatives.
dos: Do retain the shared source token names and font families when extending existing pages.
Do keep the entire Shelf bubble and tail within the viewport gutters.
Do preserve the Shelf's exact content, fixed hit areas, and keyboard and touch behavior.
Do anchor both quote and tail to the artwork when reduced motion is enabled.
donts: Don't apply the Shelf's bubble shape or local dark-blue text colors to every site container.
Don't add the rejected dark cards or accent lines back to Shelf quotes.
Don't make quote readability depend on continuous motion or hover alone.
